MRED said it defended the Objective Criteria principle established through the Department of Justice and reaffirmed by the National Association of Realtors. Under that principle, brokers and consumers may filter listings by price, property type, location, and other objective characteristics, but they cannot exclude a competitor's listings because they disagree with the lawful ways those properties were marketed.
"This is a victory for fairness, transparency, and broker cooperation — principles MRED will continue defending every day," MRED said.
